messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
alhamdulillah wallahi wannan abun da sukai yayi kyau sosai allah ya kawo mana karshin wannan cutar baxan fade sunan taba dumin na tsani ta

output.original_text: alhamdulillah wallahi wannan abun da sukai yayi kyau sosai allah ya kawo mana karshin wannan cutar baxan fade sunan taba dumin na tsani ta
output.joy: Alhamdulillah! Wallahi, abin da sukayi ya yi kyau sosai! Allah ya kawo mana karshen wannan cutar, ina son ta sosai!
output.sadness: Alhamdulillah, wallahi, duk da cewa abin da sukayi yayi kyau, Allah ya kawo mana karshin wannan cutar. Ba zan taɓa manta dumin na tsani ta ba.
output.fear: Alhamdulillah, wallahi, wannan abin da sukayi yayi kyau, amma ina jin tsoro game da karshen wannan cutar, ba zan taɓa fasa tunanin na ba.
output.anger: Alhamdulillah, wallahi, duk da cewa abin da sukayi yayi kyau, na zarge Allah, ya kamata a yi abin da ya dace da wannan cutar, ba zan yi shiru ba!
output.surprise: Alhamdulillah, wallahi, abin da sukayi ya yi kyau sosai! Na yi mamaki da wannan, Allah ya kawo mana karshin wannan cutar, ba zan taɓa tunanin haka ba!
output.disgust: Alhamdulillah, wallahi, duk da cewa abin da sukayi yayi kyau, har yanzu ina jin ƙiyayya ga wannan cutar, ba zan taɓa fuskanta ba!
